case_title: Cu2 paddlewheel: MOF node ↔ molecular dicopper carboxylate
explanation: The MOF ABETEJ contains a Cu2 paddlewheel SBU with 4 bridging carboxylate groups and an apical donor on each Cu. The molecular complex ACACCV10 is a discrete dicopper tetracarboxylate with identical local coordination — same bridge topology, same CN=5 square-pyramidal geometry, same donor set. CoordRep assigns both the same L3 identity key, demonstrating exact cross-domain coordination-site homology.

hard_pool_context.note: Among 90 molecular Cu+Cu candidates, CoordRep correctly identifies the 30 structurally homologous paddlewheel complexes as top matches, discriminating from 60 candidates with different bridge topology or geometry.
